snippet.title: Cold Ground - Trailer for upcoming retro-style RPG
snippet.description:
Cold Ground is an upcoming action RPG, using a run and gun engine that tries to emulate the style of MSX/PC-88 games.

The country of Milata has been existing as a separatist region of Dalina in a fronzen clonflict since 1991, acquiring de facto independence despite its limited recognition. After war breaks once again, a young recruit goes on a one-man army quest to save his homeland.

Coming soon for Microsoft Windows through Steam and itch.io.
US price tag: $4,99.

Dreams on Diskette
by Dreams on Diskette (Stevia Sphere)
